Fly.io is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2023 to 2026.

What it was for: [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (1), [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [sig](@/work/sig.md): distributed cognitive framework in Elixir/OTP; [korczis.gitlab.io](@/work/korczis-gitlab-io.md); [el-magico-cache](@/work/el-magico-cache.md): Elixir Cache.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Fly.io: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Fly.io to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
